title: Dynamic HDR detection honesty phase 1
summary: Adds bounded Dolby Vision and HDR10+ detection for HDR scratch copies, encode warning/events when dynamic metadata will be flattened, remux expected-pass-through evidence, additive sidecar/completed-record evidence, and focused PowerShell unit coverage.
reason: The encode route previously flattened Dolby Vision RPU and HDR10+ dynamic metadata to static HDR10 with no warning or sidecar evidence. Phase 1 makes the loss visible without changing routing, config, FFmpeg arguments, or preservation behavior.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR metadata was invisible to the pipeline. Encodes could drop Dolby Vision/HDR10+ metadata without a log warning, pipeline event, sidecar field, or completed-manifest evidence.
behavior_after: HDR encode/remux sources are probed on the scratch copy. Encodes with detected dynamic metadata log a warning and emit a dynamic_hdr_metadata_dropped event; remux records expected pass-through evidence. Immediate-publish sidecars/completed records include an additive dynamic_hdr block. SDR routing and all FFmpeg command generation remain unchanged.
